entries.title: perf(scheduler): 调度快照解码结果常驻进程内存，选号不再每次全量读取并解码分组
entries.decision: 不替换当前账号 DTO/按需详情和调度索引。上游共享可变快照 memo 缺容量上限且旧写入节点不发布新 revision，直接启用会产生混合版本陈旧调度；新增缓存不是本地已测 owner 的等价优化。

historical_references.historical_decision: | #8251 | deferred | 上游进程内快照复用会在当前候选索引中引入十秒陈旧窗口、嵌套 map/指针共享和无界条目增长；当前 writer 没有对应修订号发布。需要独立的有界不可变快照设计和混合版本失效矩阵。 |

Do not introduce process-local decoded snapshot memoization into current candidate-index and account-mutation owners. Upstream reuses nested maps and pointer fields, has no entry-count cap, and permits up to ten seconds of stale reads from writers that do not publish new revision keys. Current rolling writers do not publish those keys. Requires a separate bounded immutable-snapshot design and mixed-version invalidation matrix before activation.
